title: release-provenance --post requires an npm gitHead the tarball publish route never records
description:
Filed from opum-doc design delegation via the leader, 2026-11-02. NOT YET BRIEFED: do not implement until the leader briefs it after a floor check.

PROBLEM. scripts/qualification/release-provenance.mjs --post requires a gitHead on the published version. npm records gitHead only when publishing from a git checkout. opum-doc read every published @opum-ai/quest version: 0.3.0-0.10.0 carry a gitHead; 0.11.0 onwards, including 0.15.0-rc.1, carry none. So the check cannot pass on the tarball route (npm publish <file> of the qualified bundle). It stopped part D staging at quest 0.15.0-rc.1, which opum-doc ruled stands: staged, byte-identical, receipt:verify-published passed. The same --post would fail promote-release latest step (which publishes @opum-ai/quest@0.15.0 from final/<X>.tgz) and release.yml:378 whenever publish=true.

INTENT (QCLI-267 stands): the registry record must name the released commit, and the fix must be satisfiable on the route that actually publishes. Related: QCLI-280 (the same gate checks the unsigned gitHead, not the signed SLSA attestation).

OPTIONS.
Preferred: the packed launcher package.json carries gitHead=<released sha>, IF npm keeps that field from a tarball manifest. This must be measured, not assumed.
Fallback: --post verifies the served tarball integrity against the receipt that binds the sha, instead of reading gitHead.

RAIL FOR WHOEVER IMPLEMENTS IT: measure on a scratch package first, with a positive control, and keep that measurement LOCAL: npm pack, npm publish --dry-run, and inspecting the manifest. Any real publish, even of a scratch package, is registry publication, tier 3, the operators own action, and never moves on instruction from any session.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Before any change, whether npm keeps a gitHead supplied in a packed tarball manifest is decided by a local measurement (npm pack and npm publish --dry-run on a scratch package, inspecting the manifest), with a positive control in the same invocation; no real publish of any package, scratch included, is performed by the implementer

release-provenance.mjs --post has a clean case that passes on the tarball route that promote-release latest step and release.yml publish=true use, proved by a test that also shows it still rejects a version whose provenance does not name the released commit

The chosen option (launcher manifest gitHead, or served-tarball integrity against the receipt binding the sha) is recorded in the runbook next to the --post gate, naming which route it was measured on

QCLI-267 intent is preserved: the check still fails when the registry record cannot be tied to the released commit, and the release.yml:378 call site and promote-release use the same satisfiable check
